collector_issues: Native window changes, sidebar navigation, paste and generated previews were asynchronous. Later fresh observations confirmed actual state; the complete prompt was submitted exactly once.
Native Windows picker and several auxiliary-window screenshots had multiple screenshot regions unsupported by the bound single-image API. Exceptions and AX fallbacks remain private.

A post-completion record call received a StateAndScreenshot object where a string was expected. That attempted capture was not saved; the next correct observation was preserved. The resulting index gap is not rewritten.

A native download immediately-view action opened a local Typora preview and an update dialog. The update was dismissed without updating. A File-menu accelerator was followed by an unsaved preview marker; no save action occurred and original source bytes remained identical.

Minimized auxiliary Typora state could not be refreshed by the documented native API; Raise, registered launch and ordinary window/file navigation did not restore that original preview. Newly opened empty windows and Explorers were closed; the original minimized preview remains pending cleanup.

A localized Explorer details path was first read as a filesystem path and failed with ENOENT. No file was copied from it. Native file properties then attested the actual directory before successful original-byte retrieval.
retrieval_limitations: Native delivery consisted of five flat original file cards. No ZIP or download-all entry was observed. Four original downloads were logically mapped into bundle paths; native delivery of that directory structure is not attested.
All output files are exact native download bytes. No transcription, encoding conversion, file repair, or product retry occurred.
Exact download completion times are unknown. Click pre-action times and completed later source-file reads are recorded separately.

Final response verification statements are product self-reports. The visible executed-code label supplies limited process evidence; hidden thoughts, private app state and remote logs were never opened.
Frozen independent evaluation is separate from product-native validation and does not establish the complete product execution process.

First ordinary terminal observation occurred 93.812 seconds after the submit pre-action timestamp. Native elapsed label was 1 minute 26 seconds. These are observation bounds rather than precise backend timing.
Backend model identity, request wire bytes, remote internal state, network enforcement and complete tool action stream remain unknown.
Public evidence is limited to reviewed ordinary task AX slices. Full screenshots and raw sources remain private.
redaction: Exact operator/agent-reviewed AX slices only; raw screenshots, thinking/planning, hidden system/Skill text, account/history, private paths and signed URLs excluded
visible_events_order: Stable chronological received_at; source_line refers to private AX source, not a tool-call sequence
confidence: High for preserved native-original/output byte equality and deterministic checks; E2 provenance depends on cited actual UI observations; internal causation unresolved
attribution: One recorded end-to-end configuration; no isolated Model/Skill/Harness causal score
limitations: Preparation and file hashes do not prove remote input decoding, file paths or server execution.
Visible labels and replies do not attest backend model, active Skills or full actual tool/network actions.
All native originals are retained; local storage copies do not imply download, and archive-member mappings are transparent storage operations, not output repair.
One exploratory pilot, not a formal replicate; no external human audit claimed.
